notes.title: New Update Delayed
notes.content:
Thank you so much for all players that have played Mango's Fisharium. It's been a great week for me. Current players probably have left since Mango's Fisharium is not meant to be played over and over again (⌒▽⌒)



I have new update coming with these changes below. But I cannot upload it right now, since my mobile authenticator doesn't work. Will upload it as soon as I can



CHANGELOG 1.1

- Keyboard controller now activated only through shortcut ‘U’ or in the Settings

- When ‘Keyboard controller’ active, Left click or Right click mouse will deactivate it

- Fishing Power Bar reverted (Red to Green)

- Added option to turn off Reeling SFX (the one that keep playing when you pull up the fishing rod)

- ‘Shiny Fish Caught’ renamed to ‘Unique Shiny Fish Caught’

- Rename it too on Steam Achievement



About AI

I just realised, Steam users really hate AI. I mean, I hate it myself when I see awkward images or texts.

I did used AI to make some texts for the game. Not all though. 

It's just when I'm in rush or my left brain is dominating, so I cannot do any creative work yet.



Disclaimer again, all pixelart images in Mango's Fisharium is drawn by me. I have done solo Game Developer on mobile for 6 years now. So I can do some pixelart   ᕙᓄ(☉ਊ☉)ᓄᕗ



On the new update, I have replaced ALL AI generated texts with mine with tiny help from AI to fix my grammar (I’m no english speaker)



I will no longer use AI for any creative part (Art, Text, Sound, Images) on my game in the future

ヽ〳 ՞ ᗜ ՞ 〵ง
